hypotheses.H1: Rank variance never increases on a particular flop-to-turn branch
hypotheses.H2: On the river, zero rank variance implies equity is zero or one
hypotheses.H3: Larger rank variance always means larger variance of board-conditional equity
hypotheses.H4: The equity ordering of two hands is independent of opponent range

selection: fixed 6 textures x 8 hero representatives, discard card collisions
method: exact uniform remaining board pairs and all 990 legal opponent hands on each final board
measure: one uniform random opponent, shared board, showdown; q(B)=equity conditional on the completed board
checks: conditional total variance identities; independent public API exact turn and river checks; public API sampling on flops
limits: finite designed state panel; not all possible flops or hole cards; no betting decisions
